card.label: {rank} of {suit}

game.mustFollowSuit: You have {suit}. You must follow suit.

trump.prompt: Look at your 4 cards and pick the trump suit.
round.title: Round {n} is over
round.tie: 4–4 tie. The next round's winner gets 1 extra point.
gameOver.wonSub: Well played! You and your partner won together.
reason.ONLY_LEGAL: This is the only card you can play.
reason.PARTNER_WINNING: Your partner is already winning this trick. Play your lowest card and save your high cards.
reason.WIN_CHEAPLY: {card} wins this trick. It's the lowest card that can win.
reason.CASH_MASTER: {card} is now the highest {suit} card left. Use it to take the trick.
reason.DRAW_TRUMPS: You have many trumps. Lead trumps to clear out the opponents' trumps.
reason.RUFF: You have no {suit}. Play a trump to win the trick.
reason.OVERRUFF: An opponent has trumped. Beat it with a higher trump.
reason.DISCARD_LOW: You can't win this trick. Throw away your least useful card.
reason.SECOND_HAND_LOW: Two players still play after you. Don't spend a high card yet.
reason.LEAD_PARTNER_VOID: Your partner has no {suit}. If you lead {suit}, they can trump it.
reason.LEAD_LONG_SUIT: Lead a low card from your longest suit.
reason.SAVE_TRUMP: Keep your trumps for later, when they matter more.
reason.AVOID_OPPONENT_RUFF: An opponent has no {suit}. If you lead it, they'll trump it.
mistake.OVERTOOK_PARTNER: Your partner was already winning. Playing over them wasted a high card.
mistake.TRUMPED_PARTNER: No need to trump a trick your partner is winning.
mistake.WASTED_HIGH_CARD: {card} couldn't win this trick. A low card would have been better.
mistake.UNNECESSARY_TRUMP: You didn't need a trump to win this trick.
mistake.LED_INTO_RUFF: An opponent has no {suit}, so they can trump it.
mistake.THREW_MASTER: {card} could have won a later trick. You threw it away.
mistake.OVERPAID_WIN: You won with {card}, but {best} would also have won.
trumpHint.text: Choose {suit}: {count} of your 4 cards are {suit}, including high cards like {highCards}.
difficulty.title: Choose a difficulty
difficulty.easyDesc: Bots play any card. Good for your first games.
difficulty.hardDesc: Bots remember every card played and look for the best move.
